overview: Black bears in the woods and brown bears in the conifers, built out of the polar bear the game already has. Hold out honey or a beetroot and a bear stops meaning you harm.

1.0.3: Black and brown bear cubs wear a coat made for a cub, instead of the grown bear's drawn over the wrong shape.
A cub changes into the grown coat the moment it grows up.
A black bear stays shy of people after its chunk reloads; it used to forget.
1.0.2: Release notes rewritten to read plainly; nothing in play changes.
1.0.1: A mod menu icon of a bear's face and the beetroot that wins it over.
1.0.0: Three bears where the game had one: black in forests and jungles, brown in taigas and groves.
The polar bear is left exactly as it was.
A bear's health goes with its size, and where it is born decides which bear it is.
Hold out honey or a beetroot and a bear settles, and stops guarding its cubs against you.
It is not taming, and hitting it ends the deal.
